messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D phone/tablet-friendly solitaire roguelike card game with D&D-style fantasy art, stats, turn-based combat, and 1–6 attack rolls where 1 always misses and 6 always crits.

## Requirements
- “Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.”
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with four encounters, a shuffled card deck, focus/guard/vitality stats, healing potions, a route map, keyboard controls, and win/defeat states.
- Used CSS-drawn fantasy scene and character art; no external image assets required.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the playable game.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright.
- Checked desktop and mobile layouts; mobile had no horizontal overflow.
- Saved screenshots at `screenshots/desktop.jpg` and `screenshots/mobile.jpg`.

### Active
- Fix/verify document structure after moving the hand section outside `.game-grid` to improve mobile layout.
- Recheck browser console and gameplay after the latest HTML edit.

### Blocked
- Browser console reported only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), not a gameplay error.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` structure around the closing tags for `.game-grid`, `.hand-area`, and `main`; the recent edit moved a closing section tag and may have introduced mismatched nesting.
2. Reload the page, test a card action and end-turn behavior, then inspect console.
3. Save and read a fresh JPEG screenshot (latest only) after corrections.
4. Summarize implementation and reasonable assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, panels, controls, dialog markup.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and CSS-drawn scene/card artwork.
- `game.js`: Game state, card play, dice, enemy turns, encounter progression, dialogs.
- `screenshots/desktop.jpg`: Earlier desktop visual check.
- `screenshots/mobile.jpg`: Earlier mobile visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The latest edit removed a `</section>` before `.hand-area` and added one after it; this was intended to close `.game-grid` before the hand, but needs structural verification.
- Game rules: 1 always misses; 6 always hits for double damage; regular hits depend on card thresholds; power adds attack damage; guard absorbs enemy damage.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D phone/tablet-friendly solitaire roguelike with D&D-style fantasy art, stats, turn-based combat, and 1–6 attack rolls where 1 always misses and 6 always crits.

## Requirements
- “Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.”
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with four encounters, deck-based combat, focus/guard/vitality, healing potions, a route map, keyboard controls, and win/defeat states.
- Used CSS-drawn fantasy scene and character art; no external image assets required.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game.
- Fixed document nesting so `.game-grid` closes before `.hand-area`.
- Reloaded the game and verified the browser console has no errors or warnings; `node --check game.js` passes.

- Verify gameplay by playing a card and ending a turn, then capture and inspect fresh desktop/mobile JPEG screenshots after the HTML structure fix.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Test card play and end-turn behavior in the browser; check console afterward.
2. Save fresh JPEG screenshots at viewport widths ≤1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.
3. Summarize the implementation and briefly note assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout and dialogs.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and CSS-drawn scene/card artwork.
- `game.js`: Game state, card play, dice, enemy turns, encounter progression, dialogs.
- `screenshots/desktop.jpg`: Earlier desktop visual check; predates the latest HTML structure fix.
- `screenshots/mobile.jpg`: Earlier mobile visual check; predates the latest HTML structure fix.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The local HTTP server is running on port `3002`.
- Game rules: 1 always misses; 6 always hits for double damage; regular hits depend on card thresholds; power adds attack damage; guard absorbs enemy damage.
